US President Donald Trump's former communications director Hope Hicks (r) has been ordered not to hand over documents to a House committee investigating the president (AFP Photo/Mandel NGAN)
White House
aide
Hope Hicks has tested positive for COVID-19
after traveling with President Donald
Trump
, according to multiple reports on Tuesday.
Hicks traveled aboard Air Force One with President Donald Trump to Minnesota and Ohio this week.
The news was first
reported
by Bloomberg's Jennifer Jacobs and was
confirmed
by
New York Times
correspondent Maggie Haberman.
"Some people close to Hicks were told that she is experiencing symptoms of the disease," Bloomberg
reported
.
